subject: Post-demo recap & pricing scenarios — route-add / blended unit-econ asks
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan@clearscale.ai>, Priya Desai <priya@clearscale.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & pricing scenarios — route-add / blended unit-econ asks

Jordan / Priya — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and the concrete asks we discussed so we can align legal/procurement and lock the renewal uplift. TL;DR: we scoped a primary expansion that adds a new high-throughput route for your realtime scoring model plus modest increases to chat/embedding volume. That combination changes the unit-econ profile and opens up a blended-rate window.

Key numbers from today's call (please confirm):
- Current steady-state: ~3.2M tokens / month (all routes combined)
- Q4 target (base expansion): step-up to ~6–8M tokens / month (50–150% uplift depending on adoption)
- Upside scenario: 12–15M tokens / month if new route is fully adopted by two product teams within 6–9 months

What we need from you to finalize a commercial:
1) Budget range: confirm an expected monthly budget band for FY29 (e.g., $6k–$12k / month or $72k–$144k annual) so we can pick the right commitment and discount band.
2) Target unit-econ: you mentioned $/1M target earlier — sounds like ~$900/1M tokens as a preferred anchor. Confirm whether that is still the target for the blended package or if procurement needs a lower cap.
3) Route requirements: the new scoring route requires short sequences and high concurrency (we recommended a dedicated pool for predictable p95 latency). Confirm whether you want that as a Dedicated capacity add-on or to start on Hosted with a canary.

Attached are two files: pricing-scenarios-20280612.xlsx (three blended-rate scenarios + sensitivity tables) and MAP-v1-ClearScale.pdf (mutual action plan with milestones). Ben and Marissa — I added the initial numbers in the sheet; feel free to update before we send the formal quote.

Next steps: Jordan / Priya — if you can confirm items 1–3 by EOD Friday (6/16) we’ll generate a formal renewal addendum and a deal summary for procurement. If procurement wants a one-page T&Cs summary, loop them in and we’ll produce that the same day.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: pricing-scenarios-20280612.xlsx (xlsx), MAP-v1-ClearScale.pdf (pdf)

From: Jordan Miles <jordan@clearscale.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@clearscale.ai>, procurement@clearscale.ai
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & pricing scenarios — route-add / blended unit-econ asks

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap and for putting the scenarios together. A few quick answers and clarifications from our side:

1) Budget band: leadership gave us a preliminary range of $8k–$11k / month for FY29 (so about $96k–$132k / year). We may push toward the high end if we can guarantee the latency SLA for the scoring route.

2) Target $/1M: $900/1M is a reasonable anchor for me and the product team. Procurement is going to try to move that down during negotiations, but if you can show the blended math that lands at ~$900 with the Dedicated route add-on, that will help.

3) Route model: our scoring route is latency-sensitive and short-sequence (<64 tokens). We prefer Dedicated capacity for p95 consistency. Start with a small dedicated pool that can autoscale; we'll evaluate usage over Q3.

On the attachments — saw the spreadsheet. A couple asks for Ben/Marissa: can you add a sensitivity row that shows blended $/1M if the scoring route takes only 30% adoption vs 60% adoption (same total tokens but reallocated)? Also include a row that models an initial 6-month ramp vs immediate adoption.

Procurement (looping in procurement@clearscale.ai) — can you confirm whether ClearScale prefers a 12-month or 24-month commitment for the Reserved capacity portion? Jordan — we can be flexible here but pricing bands will shift.

I'll aim to get a final budget sign from leadership by next Wednesday.

— Jordan
VP Product | ClearScale AI

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan@clearscale.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & pricing scenarios — route-add / blended unit-econ asks

Jordan — appreciate the clarity. I updated the spreadsheet (pricing-scenarios-20280612.xlsx) with two sensitivity tables per your asks:
- Adoption split: 30% vs 60% adoption for the scoring route (same overall token volumes)
- Ramp profile: immediate vs 6-month linear ramp

Quick notes on the blended math that should help procurement:
- Hosted baseline model (chat & embeddings): assume $1,200 / 1M tokens at list in the attached scenarios (this represents the set of open models you trialed).
- Scoring route (dedicated instances, quantized model): effective ~$600–$850 / 1M tokens depending on pool size and commitment (larger reserved pool -> lower per-1M price).
- Blended bucket: with your 6–8M target, the blended $/1M sits in the $820–$940 range under the 12-month commitment scenarios; at 12–15M blended moves toward $700–$850 / 1M.

Ben added conservative TCO numbers for on-call/ops in the MAP. Note that the first-line discounting we can offer in a renewal addendum is driven by committed spend bands (we outlined three bands in the sheet).

Next steps from Redwood ops side:
- I’ll scope the Dedicated pool sizing estimate (GPU count / vCPU / RAM profile) and share by EOD Friday.
- Marissa — can you draft the short renewal addendum language (1 page) that states committed monthly tokens, blended rate range, and rollback/fallback to Hosted if Dedicated fails the SLA? Procurement typically requires simple fallback language.

Jordan / Priya — if procurement confirms 24-month vs 12-month preference that will materially improve the blended price.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Priya Desai <priya@clearscale.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Miles <jordan@clearscale.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearscale.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & pricing scenarios — route-add / blended unit-econ asks

Thanks Ben — the updated sheet looks good. Procurement prefers to see both 12- and 24-month commitment tables; can Marissa include both in the addendum? Two additional asks before we can circulate to procurement leadership:

1) Show a single-line summary that maps to "effective monthly spend" for the blended scenarios (i.e., if we pick blended $850/1M at 8M tokens, show $6,800 / month). Procurement wants the one-line number top-of-page.
2) Can you confirm any early-termination economics? We need to understand how reserved pool credits are handled if adoption stalls.

If Redwood can provide those two items plus the Dedicated sizing estimate, we should be ready to get procurement leadership into the thread next week.

Priya Desai
Head of Procurement | ClearScale AI
procurement@clearscale.ai
